title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned grounded candidate 4 of 7 — the cold-storage specimen archive. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Comps are in .impeccable/mocks/decision/ (assigned.png, pick.png, canon.png).

options.label: The Specimen Archive
options.lineage: cold-storage cryogenic specimen archives and cryobox rack inventories
options.thesis: The catalog is an addressable archive: every compound is a labelled specimen with a rack coordinate and a full specification record.
options.viewport: A rack index band addresses the board; the hero pairs one photographed vial with its spec record; below, the whole catalog is a cryobox grid where every cell is a real, differently-named compound with its own lot.

raised.raise: Specification values are annotated to the specimen they describe, pinned by leader lines to the record, rather than parked in a table beside it.
Availability prints inside the cell that owns it — the grid itself carries state, with no floating badge layer over the composition.
One rack control re-addresses the entire board: a single selection changes the whole surface, not a section of it.

options.risk: A rack grid can read as inventory software if the type and rules are not held tightly, and 'archive' language drifts toward implying a facility Elune does not operate. The coordinates are the catalog's own addressing scheme, never a claim of custody.

options.label: The Regulated Label
options.lineage: regulated reagent bottle labels and pharmaceutical label standards
options.thesis: The interface is the product's own printed label, blown up: dense ruled fields, lot block, net contents and storage line.
options.viewport: An oversized white label panel dominates the first viewport, its ruled field rows carrying the full specification, with smaller label cards and a ruled index table below.
options.risk: This is the direction most runs in this category would also reach for. It wins on product clarity and recognition, not on distinctiveness.

options.label: The Tension Network
options.lineage: kinetic tensegrity sculpture — carbon rods and tension cord
options.thesis: The catalog as a load network: expose the tension and compression paths between products and let a visitor trace any value to its counterforce.
options.viewport: An engineering diagram spine — monospaced force labels pinned to nodes on leader lines, layout obeying the strut network rather than a page grid.
options.case: Fuses cleanly onto specification data and genuinely aids comparison, but its identification is civil engineering: a peptide buyer does not see themselves in it, and the breathing motion implies a live process the product does not have. Loses narrowly on identification, holds clarity.

options.label: The Modular Block System
options.thesis: Photographed reality and hard vector bars snapping together under one loud grammar of coloured blocks, moving by band, by module cell and by scene.
options.viewport: Coloured bars and photo panels as grid layers, overlaps producing secondary colours; category colour-coding as structure rather than decoration.
options.case: Fuses well: colour bands map naturally onto the five categories and the photographic panels suit vials, and it is a genuinely light-ground, printed-systems world. Loses narrowly on clarity — saturated cyan, magenta and yellow fidget against analytical sobriety and sit close to the neon register the brand bans. Would need systematic muting to survive the commitment.

options.label: The Letterpress Bill
options.thesis: A flat screened bill whose ray burst radiates from one off-centre origin, navigation following a ray outward to its billing.
options.kept: The ruled border-cell device, where navigation state is a filled cell in a printed frame — the assigned direction took this as its rack index band.

options.label: The Drawcord Structure
options.thesis: One pull transforms a flat plane into a structured volume, with cord channel, gathered region and anchor as the topology.
options.kept: The single-control transformation — one interaction reconfigures the entire surface, which the assigned direction adopted as its rack selector.

options.label: The Phosphor Terminal
options.lineage: green-phosphor terminal in a midnight machine room
options.thesis: One continuous scrolling transcript where every system state prints itself rather than appearing as chrome.
options.kept: State that prints itself in place instead of floating as chrome — the assigned direction took this for in-cell availability.

options.label: The Floated Pigment Bath
options.lineage: Ebru marbling — floated pigment on a thickened bath
options.thesis: Every mark is made by moving liquid: each drop displaces the last into rings, combed into figures and lifted once onto paper.
options.kept: The idea that a value's position is displaced by the values around it — a useful instinct for showing relative purity across a lot batch.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably — hero banner, trust badges, category cards, featured products, newsletter, footer.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
